subject: Pilot onboarding timeline & gating checklist
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@clinixhealth.com>, Pilot Ops <pilot-ops@clinixhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot onboarding timeline & gating checklist

Hi Sam / Pilot team —

Thanks again for agreeing to run the two-week pilot for streaming + function/tool calling. Attached is a concise sprint-zero checklist we use to get teams to a working sandbox: environment access, schema validation, sample tool stubs, and acceptance criteria. High-level proposal:

- Week 0 (this week): access + schema alignment, compute sizing call
- Week 1: sandbox integration, streaming + function call PoC, basic structured output validation
- Week 2: performance smoke tests, eval prompt set, go/no-go decision and next steps

Key asks from your side: 1) provide a list of dev emails to whitelist for the sandbox, 2) confirm the JSON schema fields you want enforced in structured outputs, and 3) nominate a security contact for audit-log/retention questions.

I attached: pilot-checklist.xlsx (checklist), schema-examples.json (example payloads). Can we lock a 30-minute kickoff on Monday 9/15? I can do 10:00–12:00 PT.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachments: pilot-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet); schema-examples.json (json)

From: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@clinixhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Pilot Ops <pilot-ops@clinixhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Sep 2025 14:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding timeline & gating checklist

Hi Ben —

Appreciate the checklist. Quick notes from our engineers: 

- Monday morning is tight; can we do Tuesday 9/16 11:00 PT instead?
- Please include example JSON schema for the streaming chunk envelope and an example function/tool-call contract (we need to map tool outputs into our downstream ETL).
- Also, does Redwood's function calling support idempotent retries and how do you suggest marking tool-call side-effects in the schema?

I attached a short doc with our current tech requirements (POC_tech_requirements.pdf). Our security lead (cc'ed) will want to know audit-log retention and where logs live.

Thanks,
Sam Taylor
Head of Integrations, Clinix Health
Attachments: POC_tech_requirements.pdf

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@clinixhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Sep 2025 08:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding timeline & gating checklist

Sam —

Thanks for the questions. I've sketched a mutual action plan (MAP) with owners and acceptance criteria and attached MAP-v1.docx. Highlights:

- We will provide a sandbox API key with IP allowlist by EOD Tuesday once we receive the dev mail list.
- Streaming: use response_mode=stream for low-latency chunks; we will enable prefix caching for repeated prompt fragments to reduce cost.
- Function/tool calling: we recommend idempotency tokens in the tool-call metadata (tool_call.idempotency_key) and a 'side_effects' boolean field in responses. Our runtime stores basic call logs; for full audit you can pull audit logs (retention 90 days by default, extendable via Dedicated/Private).

Docs & links are in the Drive folder; SOW for the pilot is ready for signature if you want to proceed after the kickoff (Docusign link below).

Proposed kickoff: Tue 16 Sep 2025 11:00 PT. Ben, can you confirm attendees?

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: MAP-v1.docx
Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-pilot-pack; https://www.docusign.com/overview/ABC123

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@clinixhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding timeline & gating checklist

Sam — confirmed for Tue 16 Sep 2025 11:00 PT. Agenda: sandbox access, schema walk-through, sample function-call, acceptance criteria, next steps.

Sandbox & quick dev notes (shared below and in Drive):
- Sandbox URL: https://sandbox.redwoodinference.com/clinix/pilot-849
- Dev API key will be posted to the folder after attendee emails are received.
- Quick streaming example: POST /v1/generate with body {"response_mode":"stream","model":"rw-infer-1","input":"<prompt>"} — stream yields chunk objects matching schema-examples.json (envelope includes sequence_id, finished, payload.schema_version).
- Example function-call metadata: {"tool_call": {"name":"charge_patient","idempotency_key":"<uuid>","params":{...},"side_effects":true}}. We log tool_call.* fields in audit logs.

I'll share a short Postman collection in the Drive after the call. Looking forward.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachments: none

From: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@clinixhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Pilot Ops <pilot-ops@clinixhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 17:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding timeline & gating checklist

Thanks everyone — confirmed for 11:00 PT. Attendees from Clinix: myself (Sam Taylor), Priya Desai (security), Aaron Lee (backend). Priya will follow up with specific audit-log retention questions but the 90-day baseline sounds fine for the pilot.

Two quick asks before kickoff: 1) Can you add Priya (priya.desai@clinixhealth.com) to the sandbox allowlist? 2) Please include the Postman collection and a minimal end-to-end example that shows a streaming response that triggers a function call and the resulting structured JSON output.

See you on the call —
Sam
Head of Integrations, Clinix Health
